# Annotation guide, version 2

You are given one source file with numbered lines. Mark the places where a
small change would alter what the code does for its callers. A separate tool
checks every mark against the syntax tree and makes the change itself; you
only point. Do not write or suggest replacement code.

## What to mark

Use exactly these kinds.

| Kind | Mark this | Anchor |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `branch_condition` | A condition that decides which behavior a caller observes: a guard, a validation, a state check, a loop exit; also the logical or comparison expression that a yes-or-no function returns | The whole condition expression, without the keyword and without enclosing parentheses that belong to the statement; for a returned condition, the expression after the return keyword |
| `failure_state` | The place where the code signals failure: raising or throwing, returning an error, or passing an error on to the caller | The whole statement or expression that signals the failure |
| `state_write` | A statement that changes state which is read later: an assignment to a field, a counter, a flag or a stored value, or a call made only for its effect, such as storing, deleting, sending or writing something | The whole assignment or the whole call, including a leading await if there is one, without a trailing statement terminator |
| `error_order` | A check that is directly followed by another check, where it matters which of the two is reported or acted on first | The whole first check, from its keyword to the end of its body |
| `pure_shell_boundary` | A function that only computes from its arguments, or one that only performs effects | The whole function |

## What makes a good mark

Prefer places where a mistake would matter and could go unnoticed:

- paths taken when something is wrong, missing, malformed, late or refused;
- checks that protect a rule the rest of the code relies on;
- the order of two checks when both can be true at once;
- writes whose effect is only visible later or elsewhere.

Skip places where nothing a caller can observe would change: logging and
diagnostics only, constants defined once at the top of a file, code that
merely forwards a value.

Do not mark tests, comments, text inside string literals, or generated code.
Mark each place once per kind. Mark as many places as genuinely qualify; do
not pad the list and do not stop at a fixed number.

## Anchor rules

The anchor must be copied exactly from the file: the complete text of one
expression or statement, character for character, including line breaks if
it spans lines. Never include a trailing statement terminator such
as a semicolon: for a statement, the anchor ends where its last expression
ends. The alternatives of a match or switch arm are patterns, not condition
expressions; do not mark them as `branch_condition`. Do not shorten it, do not join lines, do not add or remove
spaces. `start_line` is the line where the anchor begins and `end_line` the
line where it ends. A mark whose anchor does not match is discarded.

## Output

Return only a JSON array, with no text before or after it. Each element:

```json
{"file": "<path as given>", "start_line": 0, "end_line": 0, "kind": "<kind>", "anchor": "<exact text>", "reason": "<one short sentence: what a caller would see change>"}
```

    1| import type {
    2|   AcceptanceCriterion,
    3|   CompletionReport,
    4|   CompletionStatus,
    5|   GatePolicy,
    6|   VerificationEvidence
    7| } from "./types.js"
    8| 
    9| export interface CompletionGateInput {
   10|   readonly policy: GatePolicy
   11|   readonly criteria: readonly AcceptanceCriterion[]
   12|   readonly evidence: readonly VerificationEvidence[]
   13|   readonly assumptions?: readonly string[]
   14|   readonly findingIds?: readonly string[]
   15|   readonly researchOnly?: boolean
   16| }
   17| 
   18| export function evaluateCompletionGate(input: CompletionGateInput): CompletionReport {
   19|   const applicableCriteria = input.criteria.filter((criterion) => criterion.status !== "not-applicable")
   20|   const failed = input.evidence.filter((evidence) => evidence.result === "fail")
   21|   const blocked = input.evidence.filter((evidence) => evidence.result === "blocked")
   22|   const notRun = input.evidence.filter((evidence) => evidence.result === "not-run")
   23|   const missingCriterionIds = applicableCriteria
   24|     .filter((criterion) => !input.evidence.some((evidence) => evidence.result === "pass" && evidence.criteriaIds.includes(criterion.id)))
   25|     .map((criterion) => criterion.id)
   26|   const hasNoApplicableCriteria = applicableCriteria.length === 0
   27|   const hasNoGateEvidence = hasNoApplicableCriteria && input.evidence.length === 0
   28|   const unresolvedRisks = collectUnresolvedRisks(
   29|     input.criteria,
   30|     input.evidence,
   31|     missingCriterionIds,
   32|     input.policy,
   33|     hasNoApplicableCriteria,
   34|     hasNoGateEvidence
   35|   )
   36|   const status = classifyCompletion(
   37|     input.policy,
   38|     input.researchOnly === true,
   39|     missingCriterionIds,
   40|     failed,
   41|     blocked,
   42|     notRun,
   43|     hasNoApplicableCriteria,
   44|     hasNoGateEvidence
   45|   )
   46|   const criteria = input.criteria.map((criterion) => classifyCriterion(criterion, input.evidence))
   47| 
   48|   return {
   49|     status,
   50|     summary: summarizeCompletion(
   51|       status,
   52|       input.policy,
   53|       missingCriterionIds,
   54|       failed,
   55|       blocked,
   56|       notRun,
   57|       hasNoApplicableCriteria,
   58|       hasNoGateEvidence
   59|     ),
   60|     criteria,
   61|     unresolvedRisks,
   62|     verificationIds: input.evidence.map((evidence) => evidence.id),
   63|     findingIds: input.findingIds ?? [],
   64|     assumptions: input.assumptions ?? []
   65|   }
   66| }
   67| 
   68| function classifyCompletion(
   69|   policy: GatePolicy,
   70|   researchOnly: boolean,
   71|   missingCriterionIds: readonly string[],
   72|   failed: readonly VerificationEvidence[],
   73|   blocked: readonly VerificationEvidence[],
   74|   notRun: readonly VerificationEvidence[],
   75|   hasNoApplicableCriteria: boolean,
   76|   hasNoGateEvidence: boolean
   77| ): CompletionStatus {
   78|   if (researchOnly && policy === "disabled") {
   79|     return "research-only"
   80|   }
   81| 
   82|   if (blocked.length > 0) {
   83|     return "blocked"
   84|   }
   85| 
   86|   if (failed.length > 0) {
   87|     return "failed"
   88|   }
   89| 
   90|   if (policy === "disabled") {
   91|     return researchOnly ? "research-only" : "partial"
   92|   }
   93| 
   94|   if (hasNoGateEvidence) {
   95|     return "partial"
   96|   }
   97| 
   98|   if (hasNoApplicableCriteria) {
   99|     return "partial"
  100|   }
  101| 
  102|   if (missingCriterionIds.length === 0 && notRun.length === 0) {
  103|     return "verified"
  104|   }
  105| 
  106|   return "partial"
  107| }
  108| 
  109| function classifyCriterion(
  110|   criterion: AcceptanceCriterion,
  111|   evidence: readonly VerificationEvidence[]
  112| ): AcceptanceCriterion {
  113|   if (criterion.status === "not-applicable") {
  114|     return criterion
  115|   }
  116| 
  117|   const mappedEvidence = evidence.filter((item) => item.criteriaIds.includes(criterion.id))
  118|   const status = mappedEvidence.some((item) => item.result === "pass") ? "verified" : "unverified"
  119| 
  120|   return { ...criterion, status }
  121| }
  122| 
  123| function collectUnresolvedRisks(
  124|   criteria: readonly AcceptanceCriterion[],
  125|   evidence: readonly VerificationEvidence[],
  126|   missingCriterionIds: readonly string[],
  127|   policy: GatePolicy,
  128|   hasNoApplicableCriteria: boolean,
  129|   hasNoGateEvidence: boolean
  130| ): readonly string[] {
  131|   const risks: string[] = []
  132| 
  133|   for (const criterionId of missingCriterionIds) {
  134|     const criterion = criteria.find((item) => item.id === criterionId)
  135|     risks.push(`${criterionId} is missing passing verification evidence.${criterion ? ` ${criterion.text}` : ""}`)
  136|   }
  137| 
  138|   for (const item of evidence) {
  139|     if (item.result === "fail") {
  140|       risks.push(`${item.id} failed: ${item.reason}`)
  141|       risks.push(item.residualRisk)
  142|     } else if (item.result === "blocked") {
  143|       risks.push(`${item.id} was blocked: ${item.reason}`)
  144|       risks.push(item.residualRisk)
  145|     } else if (item.result === "not-run") {
  146|       risks.push(`${item.id} was not run: ${item.reason}`)
  147|       risks.push(item.residualRisk)
  148|     } else if (item.residualRisk !== undefined) {
  149|       risks.push(item.residualRisk)
  150|     }
  151|   }
  152| 
  153|   if (policy === "disabled" && evidence.length === 0) {
  154|     risks.push("No verification evidence was collected because the gate is disabled.")
  155|   } else if (hasNoGateEvidence) {
  156|     risks.push("No acceptance criteria or verification evidence were provided.")
  157|   } else if (hasNoApplicableCriteria) {
  158|     risks.push("No acceptance criteria were provided.")
  159|   }
  160| 
  161|   return Array.from(new Set(risks))
  162| }
  163| 
  164| function summarizeCompletion(
  165|   status: CompletionStatus,
  166|   policy: GatePolicy,
  167|   missingCriterionIds: readonly string[],
  168|   failed: readonly VerificationEvidence[],
  169|   blocked: readonly VerificationEvidence[],
  170|   notRun: readonly VerificationEvidence[],
  171|   hasNoApplicableCriteria: boolean,
  172|   hasNoGateEvidence: boolean
  173| ): string {
  174|   const details = [
  175|     formatDetail(
  176|       "missing evidence",
  177|       hasNoGateEvidence ? ["workflow verification"] : hasNoApplicableCriteria ? ["acceptance criteria"] : missingCriterionIds
  178|     ),
  179|     formatDetail("failed checks", failed.map((item) => item.id)),
  180|     formatDetail("blocked checks", blocked.map((item) => item.id)),
  181|     formatDetail("not-run checks", notRun.map((item) => item.id))
  182|   ].filter((detail) => detail.length > 0)
  183|   const suffix = details.length > 0 ? ` ${details.join(" ")}` : ""
  184| 
  185|   if (status === "verified") {
  186|     return `Verified completion under ${policy} verification policy.${suffix}`
  187|   }
  188| 
  189|   if (status === "research-only") {
  190|     return `Research-only outcome; verification gate disabled and no completion verification was claimed.${suffix}`
  191|   }
  192| 
  193|   if (status === "blocked") {
  194|     return `Blocked completion under ${policy} verification policy.${suffix}`
  195|   }
  196| 
  197|   if (status === "failed") {
  198|     return `Failed completion under ${policy} verification policy.${suffix}`
  199|   }
  200| 
  201|   return `Partial completion under ${policy} verification policy; unresolved risks remain.${suffix}`
  202| }
  203| 
  204| function formatDetail(label: string, values: readonly string[]): string {
  205|   if (values.length === 0) {
  206|     return ""
  207|   }
  208| 
  209|   return `${label}: ${values.join(", ")}.`
  210| }
